explanation: Track a circular buffer, head index and count. When full, copy logical FIFO order into a doubled buffer. Dequeue advances head; it never shifts the queue contents.
timeComplexity: Enqueue: O(1) amortized, O(p) during growth; Dequeue/Size: O(1)
spaceComplexity: O(initial capacity + peak queue size) retained buffer space
attribution: Original Python implementation authored for EPI Practice from its displayed contract and independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference source adapted.
